title: Ken Johnston told to destroy anomalous Apollo negatives

tellings.quote: was told to destroy a bunch of like first generation or early generation Apollo negatives uh because they had some anomalies on them and they're not supposed to be there and they don't want to release them publicly and he actually saved some of them

plain: A NASA man named Ken Johnston Sr. was told to destroy early copies of Apollo photo negatives because they showed anomalies that were "not supposed to be there" and NASA did not want them released, but he secretly saved some. A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani tells Michels this as what Johnston told him. If true, NASA hid strange things seen during the moon missions.
